// diagnostic

E0721

A `{tag}` value is denied at `{api}`.

What

A `{tag}` value is denied at `{api}`.

Why

The declaration for `{tag}` lists a destination that covers `{api}`. The tag spreads with derived data until an exact-tag scrubber removes it.

Fix

Remove the destination use, change the declaration if its policy is wrong, or pass the value through `#Scrub({tag})`.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0721: Tests/UI/Taint/counted_loop_zero_iterations_keeps_pre_loop_taint.stderr.

Error [jet.InvalidOutput]: Output entry `run` has the wrong callable contract
  --> Tests/UI/Taint/counted_loop_zero_iterations_keeps_pre_loop_taint.jet:5:1
    |
  5 | run: fn(n: Int) {
    | ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: An Executable takes zero or one typed CLI parameter and declares no return type, `-> Never`, or only a unit error contract such as `IOError!`
 Fix: Declare the entry as `run: fn()` or `run: fn() IOError!`
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E1321

Error [jet.TaggedValueDenied]: A `Input` value is denied at `process.cmd`
  --> Tests/UI/Taint/counted_loop_zero_iterations_keeps_pre_loop_taint.jet:8:16
    |
  8 |     _: process.cmd(["echo", value])
    |                ^^^
 Why: The declaration for `Input` denies `Exec`, which covers this destination
 Fix: Remove the destination use, or pass the value through a matching `#Scrub(Input)` function
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0721
